# Python dependencies for the repo's TOOLING scripts (scripts/tc, scripts/gate).
# Separate from tests/e2e/requirements.txt on purpose: that file provisions the Robot
# Framework test-runner (make e2e-deps); this one provisions artifact generators only.
# Installed via `make xlsx-deps`. Never auto-installed by a build target — same precedent
# as deps.sh: host tool provisioning is a one-time setup step, not a per-run concern.
#
# RULE: appending a new pin is fine; bumping an existing one is not (see CLAUDE.md
# anti-patterns) — a silent bump can change generated bytes and trip the drift guards.

# Presentation view (`make xlsx-view` → scripts/tc/build-xlsx.py). The CSVs remain the
# only machine-read deliverable; xlsx is a gitignored downstream photograph of them.
openpyxl==3.1.5
